name: nav
description: A bar with a brand, a list of links, and actions, that collapses the links behind a toggle at its own width and opens them as a sheet, a drawer, or a screen, or puts them in a bar fixed to the bottom of the screen; with nav.js, links that do not fit the bar move into a More menu.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: The hue of the current link and of the hover tint.

attributes.name: data-threshold
attributes.description: The nav's own width at or above which the links sit in the bar; below it they are behind the toggle.

attributes.name: data-panel
attributes.description: What the links become below the threshold: a sheet under the bar, a drawer from the start edge, or the whole screen, each opened by the toggle; or bar, a row of icons and labels fixed to the bottom of the screen, with no toggle.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: Space between the bar's parts and between the links.

attributes.name: data-justify
attributes.description: Where the links sit in the bar's free room: beside the brand, in the middle between the brand and the actions, or at the end with the actions straight after them. With center or end the toggle sits at the end below the threshold.

attributes.name: data-sticky
attributes.description: Keep the bar at the top of the scrollport as the page scrolls, flush with the edge.

children.description: The site's name or mark, usually a link home.
The toggle; its popovertarget names the list's id. Hidden while the links are in the bar. Needed for every data-panel but bar, which has no toggle, so the markup may leave it out.
The links, one per li, with role="list" and the id the toggle names.
An entry in the list; each holds one link, or a dropdown: a split parent's link, toggle and panel, or a label button and its panel.
An li holding a button with popovertargetaction="hide", shown at the panel's top end corner and hidden in the bar and in a bottom bar. Required with data-panel="screen".

The More item: an li.dropdown with a label button and an empty list panel, written hidden as the last item of the list (a close item may follow it). nav.js moves the links that do not fit the bar into its panel, from the end, and shows it while it holds any; in a bottom bar with more than five links it keeps four and More. Without the module it stays hidden.

A nav item may hold a dropdown for its own children. In the bar it is the usual card, in the top layer so the bar never clips it. Behind the toggle, a split dropdown (a link and a toggle) shows its pages in place in the open panel, indented one step per level, every level open and its toggle hidden. With nav.js each group, a label-only one included, folds in place behind its button, and the branch holding the current page starts open. Without the module a label-only dropdown opens as a full-width block docked under its trigger and squared off against the open panel's edges.
A wrapper, usually a div, holding whatever sits at the end of the bar: buttons, a phone number, a version. The attribute goes on the wrapper, not on a button.

markers.name: data-brand
markers.description: The site's name or mark, usually a link home.

markers.name: data-close
markers.description: The item holding the button that closes the panel; hidden in the bar.

markers.name: data-more
markers.description: The More item, written hidden; nav.js fills it with the links that do not fit the bar and shows it.

markers.name: data-actions
markers.description: A wrapper, usually a div, holding whatever sits at the end of the bar: buttons, a phone number, a version. The attribute goes on the wrapper, not on a button.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-padding
tokens.description: Padding of the bar and of the open panel.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-radius
tokens.description: Corner of the links and the toggle.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-border
tokens.description: The bar's bottom edge, and the sheet's; the top edge of a bottom bar.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-surface
tokens.description: Background of the bar. A bottom bar takes the nav's own background, whatever sets it.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-panel
tokens.description: Background of the open panel.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-brand-weight
tokens.description: Weight of the brand.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-brand-size
tokens.description: Size of the brand; 1em keeps the bar's.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-logo-size
tokens.description: Height of a logo in the brand; the width follows the image. The default is the bar's control size, so a logo never makes the bar taller.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-panel-text
tokens.description: Text of the open panel, its links and its close button. Set it with --yeti-nav-panel.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-link
tokens.description: Color of a plain link in the bar and of each top-level dropdown's own link and button; the bar's own color unless set. The current link takes --yeti-nav-current and a hovered one --yeti-nav-hover. It does not reach a dropdown's panel, and the open panel resets it to its own text color.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-hover
tokens.description: Background of a link or top-level dropdown trigger in the bar under the pointer; not the nav's toggle, and not items in a dropdown's floating panel, which take --yeti-dropdown-hover. The open panel keeps the variant's subtle tint on its own surface. Read with a fallback to the variant's subtle tint; set transparent to turn the fill off.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-current-surface
tokens.description: Background of the current page's link in the bar and of the top-level parent that holds it; off unless set. It does not reach a dropdown's floating panel or the open panel.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-current
tokens.description: Color of the current page's link in the bar and of the top-level parent that holds it; a dropdown's floating panel takes --yeti-dropdown-current, and the open panel keeps the variant's text color on its own surface. Read with a fallback to the variant's text color.

tokens.name: --yeti-stretch-small
tokens.description: font-stretch of a link.

tokens.name: --yeti-control-size
tokens.description: Minimum height of the bar, the toggle, and each link.

tokens.name: --yeti-shadow-md
tokens.description: The open panel's shadow.

tokens.name: --yeti-shadow-color
tokens.description: The drawer's backdrop.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-text
tokens.description: The bar's text, and the open panel's.

tokens.name: --yeti-border-width
tokens.description: Width of the bar's bottom edge, of the sheet's, and of a bottom bar's top edge.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-sm
tokens.description: The default gap; a link's inline padding and the close item's inset follow it.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary
tokens.description: The default variant's color, when data-variant is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary-subtle
tokens.description: The default variant's tint.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary-soft
tokens.description: The default variant's soft stop.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary-strong
tokens.description: The default variant's strong stop.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary-text
tokens.description: The default variant's text color.

tokens.name: --yeti-on-primary
tokens.description: Text on the default variant's color.

tokens.name: --yeti-weight-strong
tokens.description: Weight of the brand, and of the current page's link.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-md
tokens.description: How far each level of a submenu shown in place in the open panel is indented.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-xs
tokens.description: Block padding of a link, and of the close button; the padding of a bottom bar and of each item in it.

tokens.name: --yeti-duration-fast
tokens.description: How long the panel takes to open.

tokens.name: --yeti-duration-base
tokens.description: How long a group in the open panel takes to fold or unfold.

tokens.name: --yeti-ease
tokens.description: The curve of that transition.

tokens.name: --yeti-text-sm
tokens.description: Text size of a label in a bottom bar.

tokens.name: --yeti-leading-sm
tokens.description: Line height of a label in a bottom bar. An icon there is one line tall, so an item is two lines plus its padding.

tokens.name: --yeti-text-lg
tokens.description: Text size of the links in a screen panel.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-xl
tokens.description: Inset of a screen panel that has no close item.

keyboard.action: On the toggle, opens or closes the list. With nav.js, on a group's button in the open panel, opens or closes that group in place.
From the toggle, into the open list's first link.
Closes the open list and returns focus to the toggle.

a11y.notes: Give the nav an aria-label, since a page often has more than one. The toggle needs a name (aria-label or visible text); the browser sets its expanded state. Mark the current page's link with aria-current="page". Put role="list" on the ul, because the reset only removes list markers where that role says the list is decorative. With data-panel="screen" there is no outside to click, so include the close item. With data-panel="bar" every link keeps a visible label beside its icon, and the icon is decoration: aria-hidden on an svg, an empty alt on an img. A split parent's toggle has no text, so give it an aria-label that names its pages. Never write aria-expanded: the browser reports a popover's state, and nav.js sets the attribute on each group's button only while the open panel shows it. The More item's button needs a name, from its visible text, in the page's language. When a link with focus moves into More's closed panel, nav.js puts focus on the More button.

guarded: anchor positioning with anchor-scope (fallback: the sheet starts at the top of the viewport, a label-only submenu in the open panel, without the module, docks to the foot of it, and a dropdown in a bottom bar is centred by the user agent)
